content.title: About
content.content: Sugar with cinnamon is a blend of white sugar and ground cinnamon, commonly used to sweeten and flavor baked goods, desserts, and drinks. The sugar provides sweetness while the cinnamon adds a warm, spicy aroma and subtle heat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Sugar‑cinnamon mixes are often sold in pre‑measured packets for topping rolls and croissants.
Cinnamon contains aromatic compounds such as cinnamaldehyde that give it its distinctive scent.
The blend can be used as a topping for toast, yogurt, oatmeal, and fruit salads.
Cinnamon is known for its antioxidant properties, but the benefit is reduced when combined with high‑glycemic sugar.
In many cultures the mixture is added to hot beverages like mulled wine or spiced tea.

items.title: Quick energy source
items.content: Sugar rapidly raises blood glucose, providing an immediate energy boost.

items.title: Antioxidant effect of cinnamon
items.content: Cinnamon contains polyphenols that may help combat free radicals.

items.title: Flavor enhancement without artificial additives
items.content: The blend allows you to avoid synthetic flavorings while delivering a natural taste.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Sugar can cause rapid spikes in blood sugar, which is a concern for people with diabetes or pre‑diabetes.

items.title: Cinnamon allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to cinnamon, such as skin itching or swelling.

items.title: Overconsumption
items.content: Excessive sugar intake is linked to weight gain, tooth decay, and increased risk of metabolic diseases.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Sprinkle the mix on finished pastries, add it to dough, top yogurt, oatmeal, fruit salads, or stir into hot drinks. Lightly toasting the blend in a dry pan can intensify its aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For longer storage, refrigerate to prevent clumping and preserve flavor.
